h: פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי מוֹת, י׳ Acharei Mos, 10
Shabbos Torah Fills Both Chambers of the Heart

p: "To declare Your kindness in the morning
and Your faithfulness in the nights" (Tehillim 92:3).
דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא אֶרֶץ וְגוֹ׳ (תְּהִלִּים נ, א)
spoke and called the earth,' etc." (Tehillim 50:1).
That is, the three holinesses of the Avos,
which are the three holinesses of Shabbos,
the daughter is crowned with the Avos
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ, וַיַּקְהֵל, חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
(as written in the holy Zohar, Vayakhel, II 204a).
corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is a chariot for the attribute of Chesed,
וּכְתִיב חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל הַיּוֹם (תְּהִלִּים נב, ג)
and it is written, "The kindness of El is all day" (Tehillim 52:3);
for Yitzchak Avinu is a chariot for this attribute,
Yaakov Avinu is a chariot for this Name.
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג סה, א)
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar (III 65a):
this is the light of Chochmah,
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה ב, ג)
and this is as they said (Bereishis Rabbah 2:3):
"'Let there be light': this is Avraham,"
for he was the beginning of the light,
who understood all the words of Torah
for Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for this attribute;
"Earth" is the name of Knesses Yisrael,
the daughter crowned with the Avos.
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ לְעֵיל מִינַּהּ
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar just before:
the Avos come together with the Matronisa,
and as written in the holy Zohar (Vayakhel, there):
"the shin is the secret of the three Avos,
who are united with the only daughter,
and she is crowned with them," etc.
"And the Holy One, blessed be He, speaks with her
to spread His wings over her";
and this is what it says,
And it says, "To declare Your kindness in the morning":
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג סד, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (III 64b):
that this morning is Avraham's? etc.
'And Avraham arose early in the morning.'"
And this is what it says,
"To declare Your kindness in the morning,"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
"'And I will tell' or 'and he told'
and so all of them, as we learned,
that it is the secret of Chochmah," etc.;
this is the light of Chochmah,
words that draw a person's heart
one merits the light of Chochmah;
and this is what is said,
along the lines of what is written
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
is the meal of the Field of Apples,
and then one merits through emunah
to sense the words of Torah,
merits words of Torah on Shabbos;
only to occupy themselves with words of Torah,
as they said (in the Pesikta and Tanchuma,
הוּבָא בְּבֵית יוֹסֵף, אוֹרַח חַיִּים סִימָן רפח)
cited in the Beis Yosef, Orach Chaim siman 288);
for about this they said in the Yerushalmi
only to occupy oneself in them with words of Torah";
and as they said (beginning of Seder Eliyahu Rabbah):
"Let Shabbos be made entirely Torah," etc.
And this is what it says (Tehillim 147:19),
and as written in the holy Zohar
this is as it is written,
a drawing from the light of Chochmah,
but "His statutes and His judgments to Yisrael,"
which is on a higher level.
who are free for words of Torah
all the days of the week
and occupy themselves in the toil of Torah,
"'His statutes and His judgments to Yisrael':
these are the secrets of the Torah,
and the laws of the Torah,
and the hidden things of the Torah," etc.
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם ע״ב)
And this is as written in the holy Zohar (there, 73b):
these are the laws of the King;
these are the decrees of the Torah.
is called the law of the King,
the Holy One, blessed be He, etc.;
and they are judgment and mercy;
'His statutes and His judgments to Yisrael,'" etc.
And this is what it said,
"these are the secrets of the Torah":
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, פִּנְחָס, רטו, סוֹף ע״א)
(as written in the Ra'aya Mehemna, Pinchas, III end of 215a);
corresponding to the five books of the Torah," etc.;
and this is "His light shall rest upon it."
and the hidden things of the Torah"
and they are Torah she'b'al peh, the halachos,
"and the hidden things of the Torah,"
which talmidei chachamim merit on Shabbos.
the Shabbosos were given for delight,
for they merit words of Torah
in the song for this meal
"May He reveal to us its reasons," etc.,
And on Shabbos the psalm begins
which alludes to the Written Torah
Chochmah and a Torah of kindness
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג סז, סוֹף ע״א)
נַפְשִׁי אִוִּיתִיךָ בַּלַּיְלָה וְגוֹ׳ (יְשַׁעְיָה כו, ט)
"'My soul, I desired You in the night,' etc. (Yeshayahu 26:9):
'my soul desired You in the night'
'also my spirit within me, I seek You':
in terms of "my soul" and "my spirit";
the Holy One, blessed be He,
is the spirit and soul of all," etc.
That is, David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
and they gave him the ruach of Atzilus,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב צד, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (II 94b).
And this is what it says, "My soul, I desired You":
"You are my soul and my spirit."
That is, all of Yisrael merit this,
that the Holy One, blessed be He,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ה, ב)
'the Rock of my heart and my portion,'" etc.;
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קכח, רֵישׁ ע״ב)
and so wrote the holy Zohar (II beginning of 128b).
who dwells among the children of Yisrael,"
וְהַיְינוּ בְּלֵב חָכָם לִימִינוֹ (קֹהֶלֶת י, ב)
that is, in "the heart of the wise man is to his right" (Koheles 10:2),
in the heart of the wise man.
that his heart be a dwelling
for the upper and lower Shechinah,
in the two chambers of the heart,
"and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there"
וְעַל זֶה אָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם ע״ב)
And about this the holy Zohar says (there, 67b):
"'Also my spirit within me, I seek You':
when there is awakened in me
'for when Your judgments are on the earth':
That is, when one merits on Shabbos
which are "the laws of the Torah
which is the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
which is from the dew of Atika,
that was hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh,
from the heart of the fool as well.
כְּדֵין צֶדֶק לָמְדוּ יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְכוּלֵּי
"Then 'the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness,'" etc.
When do "the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness"?
To teach the heart of the fool as well,
"when Your judgments are on the earth,"
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah:
the Holy One, blessed be He;
and then "the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness,"
that there be a dwelling for the Shechinah
in the two chambers of the heart.
And this is what it said,
"My soul, I desired You in the night":
in "the heart of the wise man to his right,"
for the Holy One, blessed be He,
"Also my spirit within me, I seek You":
this is the Holy One, blessed be He;
and that is "when Your judgments are on the earth,"
when one merits statute and judgment;
and then "the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness,"
that even the heart of the fool
to make a dwelling for them
in the two chambers of the heart,
"and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there";
and this one can merit on Shabbos.
